Create ONE final static factual editorial illustration, exact 1200 x 630 PNG composition on pure white, sophisticated crisp textbook ink-and-gouache finish. This is a conceptual illustration, not CAD. Subject: United restricts unauthorized personal third-party agent access, citing credentials, unintended transactions, loyalty miles and human check-in acknowledgments. Qualification: The notice states United policy and cited risks, not measured incident rates or a universal airline rule. Composition: A left incoming abstract agent request ends at a thick broken-access boundary in the center. Right is a cutaway risk compartment with separate credentials, transaction, loyalty and check-in regions represented abstractly. Nothing crosses the denied boundary; detached note below. Palette: brick red and midnight navy. Show source-supported meaningful components: Unauthorized request envelope, attempted access line, restriction boundary face, blocked endpoint, direct-platform boundary, agency distribution branch, aggregator distribution branch, credential compartment, purchase compartment, account-change compartment, loyalty-mile compartment, human-acknowledgment boundary. Only the attempted access arrow reaches the restriction; right compartments have nondirectional grouping, never successful booking arrows. Render ONLY these four exact strings, once each: ["Unauthorized agents","Restricted access","Account and check-in risks","United policy, not incident statistics"]. Three main labels bold dark 38px minimum at final resolution, caveat 30px. Follow the specified label boxes; all glyphs at least 52px inside image edges. Explanatory objects occupy 65-75 percent of canvas. Connector endpoints must attach to real pictured object ports, never words. Caveat must be fully detached from arrows. No generic dashboard/card grid, logos, people, robot/avatars, shields, gears, control knobs, decorative scenery, pseudo-text, simulated writing, unsupported bars, extra numbers, invented success checkmarks or additional wording. All otherwise unlabeled object faces must be completely smooth and blank. Exclusions: No robot, shield, tick, approved booking route, authorization service or invented policy-control UI. Do not imply permitted Book/Change/Manage flow.
